_about: FLUF awareness (A2, 26 Oct 2026; docs\MOD_COMPATIBILITY.md FLUF): one choice of how FLvibed treats FLUF's windows, in the controller's SYSTEM section after run_in_background. No effect without FLUF.

rows.label: FLUF windows
rows.help: Only with FLUF installed. Player windows: FLvibed's HUD, prompts and subtitles step away from FLUF's palette, options window, map and notifications, and the controller drives them; All: also FLUF's developer windows (its Debug Window); Ignore: FLvibed's layout as without FLUF. FLvibed's keys always pass to FLUF's text box while you type in it.
